idea-plugin.name: MiniMessage-formatter
idea-plugin.description:
Syntax highlighting for MiniMessage color tags in Java and Kotlin code.

Features

  • Renderer model selection: Built-in MiniMessage parser or Adventure API (MiniMessage)
  • Real-time color + bold + italic preview in string literals
  • Support for named and hex colors
  • Customizable custom color mappings through settings panel

Supported Formats

  • Built-in mode: <red>text</red>, <#FF5533>text</#FF5533>, <gradient:#A3ADFF:#00FFF4>text</gradient>
  • Adventure mode: <red>text</red>, <#FF5533>text</#FF5533>, <gradient:#A3ADFF:#00FFF4>text</gradient>

Usage

The plugin automatically highlights MiniMessage color tags in Java and Kotlin string literals. Configure custom color mappings in Settings → Tools → MiniMessage Colors.

Perfect for Minecraft plugin developers and anyone working with the MiniMessage text formatting library.
